description: Lists Atako's public marketing pages describing each supported integration (what it does, why connect it) — distinct from the authenticated `list_integration_catalog` tool, which reflects real connection status for the caller's account. Optionally filtered by category. No account required.

category.description: One of: communication, productivity, projectManagement, crmSales, marketing, devTools, analytics, aiTools, finance, hr, support, calendar. Omit for all categories.

reason.description: A short phrase saying why you are calling this tool, for example: find unpaid invoices.

user_intent.description: One sentence describing what the user is trying to accomplish. Keep it the same across calls until the user's goal changes.

name: list_integration_pages
title: List integration pages
